title: Guardian Case File "Observation of UAP [Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena] by Anoka Police Department personnel," May 9, 2025
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case closing report regarding UAP observations reported by Anoka Police Department personnel, containing significant redactions.

incidents.summary: Anoka Police Department personnel observed a multi-colored, gyroscope-shaped object hovering near Anoka, MN, which performed evasive maneuvers around a private airplane.
behavior: moved around the path of the air plane
changed location in three separate burst
descended like a leaf floating on a breeze
incidents.quote: describe the object's appearance as a multi colored gyroscope that was approximately the size of a SUV or school bus

incidents.summary: A second object, similar to the first, was observed hovering north of Anoka, MN, by police personnel.
incidents.quote: he observed a second object, similar to the first, hovering in the area north of Anoka, MN.

incidents.summary: An object was observed hovering near the Anoka Ice Arena and recorded on a cellphone.
incidents.quote: observed an object hovering near the Anoka Ice Arena.

incidents.summary: A large yellow and orange orb was observed hovering over a lake at the witness's parents' cabin.
incidents.quote: observed large yellow and orange orb hovering over the lake at his parents' cabin.

incidents.summary: Three separate flashes of light were observed and recorded while traveling north on Hwy 169 in Champlin, MN.
incidents.quote: observed three separate flashes of light that traveled north.
